properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Key Vault: Purge Protection Required
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure Key Vaults without purge protection enabled. FedRAMP High requires information system backup (CP-9). Purge protection prevents permanent deletion of vaults and their objects during the soft-delete retention period — even by privileged administrators — ensuring cryptographic material cannot be irrecoverably destroyed.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Key Vaults without purge protection. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
